quickAnswer: Choosing between tourist entry and a medical visa for Turkey depends on your nationality and planned treatment length. Many UK, EU, and US visitors enter visa-free for short stays up to 90 days in 180 days, while others require a consular medical visa. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.

body.text: Official visa and residency rules are decided solely by Turkish consulates and the Presidency of Migration Management (Göç İdaresi). Always verify your passport's current entry rules before booking.
Can most UK, EU and US patients enter on a standard tourist entry for short treatments?

For short diagnostic check-ups, consultations, or routine procedures lasting well under 90 days, many UK, EU, and US passport holders qualify for standard visa-free entry (up to 90 days within any 180-day period). Exact exemptions vary by nationality and must be confirmed on official Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs listings.

Check your country's rules on the [Republic of Türkiye MFA Visa Information page](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa) and verify passport expiry. Under Law No. 6458 Article 7.1b ([MFA Passport Validity Requirements](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/passport-validity-requirements-while-entering-turkey-in-accordance-with-law-on-foreigners-and-international-protection.en.mfa)), your passport must remain valid at least 60 days beyond your stay limit (150 days for a 90-day stay; six months advised). If your nationality requires an electronic tourist visa, apply only on the official [e-Visa portal](https://evisa.gov.tr/register/)—never lookalike sites, as warned by the [Turkish Embassy in New Delhi](https://newdelhi-emb.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowAnnouncement/361514).
When is a formal Turkish medical visa required (longer stays or specific nationalities)?

A formal consular medical visa is required if your nationality is not eligible for visa-free or e-Visa entry, if planned treatment exceeds tourist stay limits, or if a Turkish consulate directs you to apply for a medical sticker visa. Applications start online through the official pre-application system before a consular interview.

Per the [MFA Sticker Visa Pre-Application System](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/pre-application-system-for-turkish-sticker-visa.en.mfa) and [Turkish Consulate General in New York guidance](https://newyork-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Content/assets/consulate/images/localCache/1/d117f939-981a-4cb6-9cd3-54609b273df5.pdf), applicants upload documents online, print the signed form, and bring originals to their interview. Under Law No. 6458 ([Turkish Embassy in Bratislava](https://bratislava-emb.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowInfoNote/390206)), visa applicants must carry health insurance covering at least EUR 30,000 for acute illness and repatriation.

body.text: What hospital invitation letter is needed for a medical visa?

Turkish consulates require an original hospital acceptance or necessity letter issued on official hospital letterhead, signed and stamped by the medical institution. The letter must confirm clinical necessity, the treating hospital, estimated treatment cost, and expected duration so consular officers can verify your treatment plan and stay window.

As detailed in the [Turkish Consulate General in Karachi Medical Visa Checklist](https://karachi-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowInfoNote/415169) and [Houston Consulate guidelines](https://houston-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Content/assets/consulate/images/localCache/1/3c3d599c-2ba5-4597-84eb-f6dd6d1e1cae.pdf), consulates review this letter alongside financial solvency and insurance documents.
Medical Visa Document Checklist (Confirm with Your Local Consulate):

items: Passport valid at least 6 months from travel date with blank visa pages.
Signed sticker-visa pre-application form completed via the official Turkish consular portal.
Original signed and stamped hospital acceptance letter detailing treatment necessity, dates, and estimated cost.
Proof of financial means (recent bank statements or sponsorship letter) and flight/hotel reservations.
Compliant travel health insurance policy meeting the minimum EUR 30,000 acute-care and transfer threshold.

body.text: How do you extend a stay if medical recovery takes longer than planned?

If your physician determines that surgery recovery or ongoing therapy must continue beyond your initial visa or visa-free period, you must apply for a short-term residence permit for medical treatment before your lawful stay expires. Never overstay your entry window, as overstays trigger fines and potential re-entry bans.

Under Law No. 6458, published by the [Presidency of Migration Management (Göç İdaresi)](https://en.goc.gov.tr/residence-permit-types), foreigners receiving medical treatment (without a disease posing a public health threat) may obtain a short-term residence permit for the duration of treatment, supported by an official hospital report and verified Turkish address. faq.q: Can I enter Türkiye on a tourist e-Visa for a 3-day check-up?
faq.a: Many e-Visa-eligible nationalities use standard short-term entry for brief outpatient diagnostics if they meet all e-Visa conditions. Confirm your nationality's rules with the official Turkish MFA or nearest consulate.

faq.q: How early should I apply for a Turkish medical sticker visa?
faq.a: Apply four to six weeks before travel to allow time for the stamped hospital acceptance letter, online pre-application, and consular interview.

faq.q: Does a companion need a separate visa?
faq.a: Yes. Every accompanying spouse, parent, or relative must meet Türkiye's entry or visa requirements independently.

faq.q: What happens if I overstay my 90-day visa-free limit while recovering?
faq.a: Overstaying without applying for a Göç İdaresi residence permit before expiry can trigger administrative fines and temporary entry bans. Request a hospital report early if an extension looks likely.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye process visas or residence permits?
faq.a: No. Official visa and residency decisions are made exclusively by Turkish consulates and the Presidency of Migration Management (Göç İdaresi). We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.

faq.q: Can a hospital issue a Turkish visa directly?
faq.a: No. Hospitals issue the signed acceptance letter submitted to the consulate or Göç İdaresi, but only Turkish government authorities approve visas or residence permits.
